title: How do you measure progress in a child undergoing Speech Therapy for Autism?
metaTitle: Measuring Speech Therapy Progress in Autism | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Understand how progress is tracked and measured during Speech Therapy for children with autism at Pinnacle Blooms Network.
html: The journey of each child at Pinnacle Blooms Network is marked by distinct milestones. Our dedicated therapists use a range of assessments to measure your child's advancements in their ability to communicate, understand and express. We also value your observations as parents or caregivers and incorporate them into our evaluations, as it helps us understand your child's development more holistically. This multifaceted approach helps us in continuously improving the therapy to better suit your child’s needs.
